name: casebook
description: Local-first time tracking for school-based clinicians

scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run format:check
scripts.build:mac-arm: bun build --compile --minify --target=bun-darwin-arm64 src/server.ts --outfile dist/mac-arm/Casebook && bun run sign:mac dist/mac-arm/Casebook
scripts.build:mac-intel: bun build --compile --minify --target=bun-darwin-x64 src/server.ts --outfile dist/mac-intel/Casebook && bun run sign:mac dist/mac-intel/Casebook
scripts.build:all: bun run build:mac-arm && bun run build:mac-intel && bun run build:windows
